Output the complete piece as ABC notation.

The main section runs on a 4-bar diatonic loop of I–V–vi–IV, unchanged throughout. Thin the middle section to two voices for two descending phrases, then return with everything for the fullest passage. Dynamics start at mp, push to f in the middle and settle back to mp for a sustained tonic close. Aim for the feeling of a rainy street and an old photograph. Use no ornament symbols; write every note out. Output the complete piece as ABC notation.
